claim.why_it_matters: The general format of the SEGMENT-LIMIT clause is inside the printed level-2 box; unmarked, the format reads as level 1.
claim.detail: The general format lies inside the box that encloses all of 2.3; the markdown figure carries no level-2 box marker (page 702's boxed OBJECT-COMPUTER format uses ╔ ║ ╚ marks for the same purpose).

verdict.reasoning: The 300 dpi render of page 703 shows one ruled box enclosing all of 2.3, from the 2.3 heading through General Rule (3); the general-format line 'SEGMENT-LIMIT IS segment-number' (SEGMENT-LIMIT underlined) sits inside it. The markdown wraps every heading and paragraph through GR1 in ║ level-2 marks, but the <pre> figure carries no box mark. Page 702's transcription marks its boxed OBJECT-COMPUTER format with ╔ ║ ╚ ╝ inside the <pre>, so this edition's transcription does mark a boxed format, and the omission here leaves the format reading as level 1. The text and the underlining match; only the level-2 marking is missing. I also saw that GR (2) and GR (3) are inside the printed box but have no ║ marks in the markdown. That is a sibling defect and is not part of this claim.
